$Comment: Earned by finishing the Emerald Wilds questline's last quest.
The payout is a ClaimReward rather than a Reward, so it waits in the achievements menu to be
collected instead of landing silently at the moment the last quest is turned in.
Criteria is keyed by criterion id, and the KEY is what progress is filed under: renaming a key
POSITION, so adding one to the end is safe while inserting, removing or reordering moves every
player's progress onto a different line.
